Max Planck Summer Research Internship 2026

The Max Planck Institute invites outstanding undergraduate and master's students worldwide to join our labs for a 10-week summer research internship.

Prerequisites and Requirements

  • Enrolled in a Bachelor or Master program in Computer Science or Mathematics.
  • Strong programming proficiency in Python, C++, or Rust.
  • Prior coursework in machine learning, algorithms, or computer vision is advantageous.

Compensation

Interns receive a competitive monthly stipend of €1,800, free student housing, and reimbursement for round-trip travel costs.

Applications open on 15 January 2026 and close on 28 February 2026.
